name: Iceland
overview:
Whenever Hollywood undertakes an expedition to the far reaches of the universe, its cameras descend on Iceland. 

Otherworldly is how many describe Iceland; a spectacular yet primitive terrain that offers a glimpse of the Earth without humans. And as you ponder the meaning of our existence, you will be reminded of its insignificance when the cosmos comes to life at night. 

An aurora is the greatest show on Earth. Even the astronauts of Hollywood would agree.

seo.title: Iceland travel guide | Pareto Travel
seo.description: Visiting another planet may or may not be possible within our lifetimes, so Iceland is the next best thing.
